derivation.n_source: count of answerable holdout queries in the sealed dataset: split=holdout, stratum!=no_hit, at least one grade-3 span
derivation.method: two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson binomial interval; the floor comparison is exact rational arithmetic on the upper tail at p = 3/4, and rendered endpoints are bisection brackets of width 2^-64
